claim: Dissipation of sleep pressure was accompanied by increasing global FC in NREM sleep, and especially in the delta, sigma and beta frequencies, and decreasing global FC in the alpha band. [adenosine_sleep_pressure]
source_text: Dissipation of sleep pressure was accompanied by increasing global FC in NREM sleep, and especially in the delta, sigma and beta frequencies, and decreasing global FC in the alpha band.

claim: During REM sleep, global FC decreased in nearly all frequency bands with dissipation of sleep pressure. [adenosine_sleep_pressure]
source_text: During REM sleep, global FC decreased in nearly all frequency bands with dissipation of sleep pressure.

claim: We found that circadian rhythmicity but in particular the dissipation of sleep pressure had profound effects on global connectivity which were different for NREM sleep, REM sleep and wakefulness and varied across frequency bands. [adenosine_sleep_pressure]
